text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- PLO leader Yasser Arafat may visit Jordan in the next two days to discuss with King Hussein the outcome of last Tuesday's summit between Egyptian President Mubarak and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu in Egypt.

- Ministerial committee on development affairs discussed in lengthy meeting the efforts to develop the country's tourism industry along with plans to transform the Red Sea port of Aqaba as a tourism magnet for foreign visitors.
- Labour Minister Khasawnah gives foreign labourers employed in Jordan without work permits another three weeks to legalise their status by applying for residence.
- Jordanian prisoners in Israel appeal to the government to press Israel to release them from Israeli prisons.
- Parliament Speaker Srour denies knowledge of a coming visit to Jordan by a delegation of Israeli Knesset deputies representing Arab voters.
